assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the PR-204 denial
CPT 93247 is long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring
The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia
The submitted diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R42
The note states the study is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
